## Professional Profile {#professional-profile}

**Evolutionary** and **computational biologist** specialising in *population and landscape genomics*, *hybridisation genetics*, *phylogeography*, *systematics* and plant climate *adaptation*. My research combines whole-genome sequencing with reproducible bioinformatics and emerging scientific-AI methods to quantify evolutionary responses to environmental change across spatial and temporal scales. This work has been recognised by the *Erich Oberdorfer Foundation Research Award* (2019) and published in *New Phytologist*, *Molecular Ecology* and *Critical Reviews in Plant Sciences*. I aim to build an independent research programme that connects evolutionary genomics, interdisciplinary collaboration and biodiversity-informed policy.

## Computational and Technical Skills {#computational-and-technical-skills}

### Computational Methods, AI & Data Science

- **Artificial Intelligence & Genomic Modelling:** Application of AI-based Large Language Models (LLMs) for genome analysis, functional annotation, variant interpretation, and integrative bioinformatics workflows.
- **Machine Learning:** Deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow), model development and deployment; ensemble learning frameworks (Random Forest, BRT)
- **Statistical Modelling:** GLM/GAM, Bayesian inference, multivariate statistics; environmental association analyses (genome-environment relationships)
- **High-Performance Computing & Workflow Management**: HPC environments, Slurm job scheduling, parallel processing, Nextflow, Snakemake
- **Programming Languages:** R (Bioconductor, tidyverse), Python, Bash, Perl
- **Data Analysis & Visualization:** R (ggplot2, dplyr), Python (pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, seaborn), Jupyter Notebooks 

### Bioinformatics, Genomics and Population Genetics

- **Genome Assembly & Annotation**: De novo assembly using Illumina, ONT, PacBio HiFi and Hi-C (Flye, hifiasm, HiCanu, SPAdes, miniasm, Velvet)
- **Temporal Population Genomics**: Analysis of allele‑frequency change across time points to infer selection, simulation-based outlier detection using *Wright–Fisher* model and *Moran* model frameworks (ANGSD, GATK, BCF/SAMtools, BEAGLE, PLINK)
- **Hybridisation Genomics**: Introgression and gene flow analysis using ABBA‑BABA, TreeMix, and STRUCTURE/ADMIXTURE
- **Population Structure & Demographic Inference**: fastsimcoal2, ∂a∂i, DIYABC, demografr; phylogenomics using RAxML, MrBayes, BEAST, SplitsTree 
- **Functional & Evolutionary Genomics**: Integration of conservation-based functional scores (*phyloP* score, *GERP* score, *GPN*) to prioritise candidate loci and link constraint with allele frequency dynamics

### Landscape Ecology and Geospatial Modelling

- **Landscape Genomics**: Spatial integration of genomic and environmental data; analysis of climate-driven allele frequency shifts and isolation-by-environment patterns using GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS) and R
- **Species Distribution Modelling (SDM)**: Ecological niche modelling (MaxEnt, GLM, GAM, Random Forest, BRT) to contextualize genomic variation within environmental suitability landscapes

### Wet-lab Skills

- **Molecular Techniques:** High-throughput DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, Sanger sequencing
- **Genomic Library Preparation:** ddRAD-seq, Oxford Nanopore (DNA/RNA), Illumina library preparation
- **Microbiology:** Aseptic technique for the isolation, culturing, and maintenance of bacteria and fungi for plant microbiome analysis and pathogen assays.

## Professional Experience {#professional-experience}

### Research Scientist & Teaching Associate 
[University of Cologne, Germany | 2022 – Present](https://ag-demeaux.botanik.uni-koeln.de/)

- Coordinate theoretical modules and teach practical classes in Quantitative Biology and Population Genetics; mentor students in experimental design, phenotyping, whole‑genome sequencing (WGS) data analysis, and scientific interpretation; prepare and assess examinations.
- Organize and lead field excursions, guiding students in designing and conducting plant ecology experiments in the Ecology and Applied Biology module. 
- Investigate plant evolutionary dynamics under climate change through temporal genomics, hybridisation genetics, and common garden experiments.
- Assemble and annotate plant genomes using HiFi long-read, Hi-C, and Illumina short-read sequencing technologies.
- Associated Member, DFG TRR 341; mentor and guide MSc/PhD students within TRR‑affiliated projects.

### Postdoctoral Research Associate  
[Senckenberg/LOEWE Center for Translational Biodiversity Genomics | 2019 – 2022](https://www.senckenberg.de/en/research/institutes-overview/sbikf-institut/sbikf-ag-evolutionaere-analyse-und-biologische-archive/)

- Characterized the impact of landscape heterogeneity on fine-scale genetic structure and gene flow in Microthlaspi erraticum using whole genome resequencing.
- Dissected the effects of host genotype, microbiome, and abiotic factors on plant disease incidence.
- Assembled microbial genomes from Oxford Nanopore long-reads, polished with Illumina data.
- Validated functional roles of microbial taxa via synthetic microbiome inoculations in contrasting host genotypes
- Governance and community roles: Member, Diversity & Inclusion Committee and TBG Steering Committee; part of the Young Scientists main speaker team (ECR network collaborating with the Board of Directors).
- Organised institute-level events (annual retreats, Diversity Days, training workshops); participated in committee meetings on organisational issues and budgeting, gaining practical insight into decision-making processes.

### PhD Research Associate  
[Goethe University & Senckenberg (SBiK-F), Frankfurt | 2011 – 2019](https://www.goethe-university-frankfurt.de/45907042/Institutes_and_Facilities)

- Clarified the systematics of Microthlaspi (Brassicaceae) by describing two new genera (Ihsanalshehbazia, Friedrichkarlmeyeria) and three new species.
- Reconstructed Pleistocene range dynamics and post-glacial colonization routes of Palearctic plant populations using phylogeographic and demographic modelling.
- Integrated ecological niche modelling with population genetics to explain spatial patterns of biodiversity.
- Coordinated international fieldwork across Europe, North Africa, and Asia (planning, permits, sampling logistics)
- Disseminated results through peer‑reviewed publications and conference presentations

### Research Internship / MRes Project  
[The James Hutton Institute, UK | 2009 – 2010](https://www.hutton.ac.uk/)

- Investigated alternative splicing in barley under cold/drought stress, identifying stress-responsive variants via RNA assays (RT-PCR/qPCR).

### Lecturer in Botany/Biology

### GCE Advance Level Biology Teacher
